title: 6.11.5 Lab: A sound that varies
description: The same sound every time tires the ear. Give each catch a random pitch with .rate and random(), and give each miss one of three thuds picked at random from a list.

steps.title: A catch that never sounds the same
steps.instructions:
The starter is your 6.11.4 game. Catch a few stars and listen: the same chime, exactly the same, every time. Games vary a sound a little each time it plays so the ear does not tire of it, and `.rate` is the cheapest way, because it changes speed and pitch together (6.11.1). `random(min, max)` gives a different number between `min` and `max` every time it is asked (5.2.1).

In the catch block, on the line before `chime.play();`, give the chime a new random rate:

```js
chime.rate = random(0.8, 1.25);
```

The line runs once for each catch and asks for a new number each time, so each chime is a little higher or lower than the last. Run it and catch a few.
hints: The rate line goes just before `chime.play();`, inside the catch block, so it runs once for each catch.
In setup() it would be asked only once, and every chime would sound the same again.

steps.title: A miss picked from a list
hints: `random(3)` alone gives a decimal like 1.7, and `thuds[1.7]` is not a position. `floor` makes it a whole number.
The pick goes inside the miss block, so a new one is made for each miss.

requirements.title: Each catch has a random pitch
requirements.description: A sound's .rate is set from random(...) (straight away, or from a variable that holds the random number) right before (or right after) its .play(), in the same block, so every play asks for a new pitch. Help: 5.2.1 (Reading: Random numbers and timers)
requirements.hint: chime.rate = random(0.8, 1.25); on the line before chime.play();

requirements.title: A miss plays one of several sounds
requirements.description: Several sounds sit in a list, and an if block plays the one at a random position, a whole number made with floor and random as in 5.2.1. One line or two, and any names, all work. Help: 5.2.1 (Reading: Random numbers and timers)
requirements.hint: const pick = floor(random(thuds.length)); then thuds[pick].play(); inside the miss block.
